summary: PIM now reaches your on-premises Active Directory, granting AD access only while someone has activated it.

new.title: The hybrid worker for on-premises AD
new.text: A small domain-joined Windows server creates your admin accounts in Active Directory and puts people who activate a PIM group into its AD twin within seconds. This is a Pro preview.

new.title: See the plan before it changes anything
new.text: The hybrid worker has a plan-only mode that shows what it would change, and it updates itself to the version your ring approves.

new.title: Import all permission templates at once
new.text: Templates now has Import all, plus a quick-start template with the Entra ID role groups, imported with your own naming convention.

new.title: Create discovered resources in one place
new.text: Access > Create Discovered Resources takes you straight to the new resources Discovery found, ready to create.

new.title: Your own host name for the Manager
new.text: The setup script can give the Manager a custom host name, and mail links use it once configured.
